summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Titan Mining Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual shareholders' meeting held on June 25, 2026. All matters presented were approved, including the setting of the board size at seven, the election of all seven director nominees, and the reappointment of Ernst & Young LLP as auditors. The filing attaches a press release with detailed voting results for each director, showing overwhelming support for all nominees. This is a routine procedural update following an annual general meeting; it does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or management change. The filing is purely informational and regulatory in nature, with no material corporate action beyond standard governance.
